decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted: Site Layout Plan Proposed 4625-P-03 Rev P2, Existing and Proposed Screen Wall and Gates 4625-P-04, Planting Layout 756.19.02, Location Plan 4625-01 Rev P2, Site Block Plan Existing 4625-P-02, Site Block Plan Proposed 4625-P-03, Tree Survey Estate Frontage 756.TS.01, Site Access Design with Visibility Splays 43845/5501/SK001, Proposed Site Access Vehicle Swept Path Analysis 16.5m Articulated Vehicle 43845/5501/SK002 Rev A, Site Layout Plan Existing 4625-P-02 Rev P2 received 12/07/2018
Proposed Site Access Vehicle Swept Path Analysis 17.9m Generic Loader 43845/5501/SK003 Rev A, Proposed Site Access Vehicle Swept Path Analysis 16.5m Articulated Vehicle 43845/5501/SK002 Rev C, Site Access Design with Visibility Splays 43845/5501/SK001 Rev B, document titled Road Safety Audit Combined Stage 1 & 2 and TMS Designers Response Template Road Safety Audit Combined Stage 1 & 2 received 13/09/2018 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Alterations to junction with Faggs Road to include widening of access road, widening and replacement of service yard gate and associated landscaping.
